# Grokipedia

> > A comprehensive knowledge base covering music, firearms, mythology, technology, and popular culture

Grokipedia serves as a diverse encyclopedia spanning topics from Billboard chart-topping music and hip-hop albums to rifle cartridges and ballistics, Proto-Indo-European mythology and linguistics, Unix/Linux systems, and entertainment media. The site provides detailed reference material across technical, cultural, and historical domains.

## Key Topics

- Billboard Hot 100 and Billboard 200 charts
- Rifle cartridges and big-game hunting ammunition
- Proto-Indo-European mythology and etymology
- Weatherby firearms and Roy Weatherby
- .300 Winchester Magnum and .30-06 Springfield
- SAAMI ballistics standards
- Def Jam Recordings and hip-hop albums
- Britney Spears and teen pop music
- Max Martin production
- Avestan and comparative mythology
- RIAA certifications
- UK Singles Chart
- Dance-pop and 1999 pop music
- Unix/Linux device files
- Music videos and debut singles

## Firearms & Ammunition

- [.338 Lapua Magnum](https://grokipedia.com/page/.338_Lapua_Magnum): Long-range precision rifle cartridge standardized for military use
- [.300 Weatherby Magnum](https://grokipedia.com/page/.300_Weatherby_Magnum): High-velocity .30 caliber rifle cartridge by Roy Weatherby
- [.270 Winchester](https://grokipedia.com/page/.270_Winchester): Winchester's 1925 high-velocity big-game hunting rifle cartridge
- [.30-378 Weatherby Magnum](https://grokipedia.com/page/.30-378_Weatherby_Magnum): Extreme velocity .30 caliber cartridge developed by Roy Weatherby
- [.325 Winchester Short Magnum](https://grokipedia.com/page/.325_Winchester_Short_Magnum): 8mm short magnum cartridge for big-game hunting by Winchester

## Music & Albums

- [... And Then There Was X](https://grokipedia.com/page/..._And_Then_There_Was_X): DMX's third studio album released 1999 via Ruff Ryders/Def Jam
- [(You Drive Me) Crazy](https://grokipedia.com/page/(You_Drive_Me)_Crazy): Britney Spears' 1999 pop single from Baby One More Time album
- [...And Then You Shoot Your Cousin](https://grokipedia.com/page/...And_Then_You_Shoot_Your_Cousin): The Roots' 2014 concept album on Def Jam Recordings
- [...And Then There Were Three...](https://grokipedia.com/page/...And_Then_There_Were_Three...): Genesis' 1978 album marking transition to trio lineup
- [(Love Is) Thicker Than Water](https://grokipedia.com/page/(Love_Is)_Thicker_Than_Water): Andy Gibb's 1977 chart-topping single co-written with Barry Gibb
- [+−=÷× Tour](https://grokipedia.com/page/+–=÷× Tour): Ed Sheeran's fifth concert tour celebrating five studio albums

## Mythology & Linguistics

- [*H₂epom Nepōts](https://grokipedia.com/page/*H₂epom_Nepōts): Proto-Indo-European reconstructed water deity from comparative mythology
- [*Manu and *Yemo](https://grokipedia.com/page/*Manu_and_*Yemo): Proto-Indo-European twin progenitors from cosmogonic mythology

## Technology & Computing

- [/dev/zero](https://grokipedia.com/page/%2fdev%2fzero): Unix/Linux special device file providing infinite null byte stream

## Film & Entertainment

- [...And Justice for All (film)](https://grokipedia.com/page/...And_Justice_for_All_(film)): 1979 legal drama starring Al Pacino as Baltimore defense attorney
- [... All the Way, Boys!](https://grokipedia.com/page/..._All_the_Way,_Boys!): 1972 Italian adventure comedy starring Terence Hill and Bud Spencer
- [(Blooper) Bunny](https://grokipedia.com/page/(Blooper)_Bunny): 1991 Warner Bros. Merrie Melodies mockumentary animated short

## Media & Journalism

- [-30-](https://grokipedia.com/page/-30-): Traditional journalism symbol marking end of news story or dispatch
